newsitem.title: UK: CASPIAN IN TALKS WITH PSV EINDHOVEN - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: CASPIAN IN TALKS WITH PSV EINDHOVEN - PAPER.

text.p: Caspian Group Plc , owners of English premier league soccer team Leeds United, has held talks with Dutch club PSV Eindhoven about an alliance, the Financial Times said on Wednesday.
The talks concerned a possible exchange of equity stakes and an agreement to share players, the newspaper said.
English soccer teams are barred from buying into their domestic rivals.
PSV Eindhoven, owned by Philips Electronics NV , won the Dutch league championship last weekend and will compete in the lucrative Champions League next season, starting in September.
The Financial Times said Caspian had also talked to two other Dutch teams, ADO Den Haag and Sparta Rotterdam, but only PSV Eindhoven had responded positively.
